map.机车（牵引力/功率）匹配 使用指南: Locomotive (Tractive Effort / Power) Matching User Guide
map.机车牵引力与功率匹配工具按输入参数计算机车牵引特性与功率需求，适合机车选型、列车: The locomotive tractive effort and power matching tool computes traction characteristics and power demand from the inputs, suited to locomotive selection, train consist planning and line traction checks.
map.功率 = A × B (W)，1 kW = 1000 W: Power = A x B (W), 1 kW = 1000 W
map.机车选型：按牵引质量与限制坡度求所需挽力，结合运行速度换算牵引功率，校核机型功率: Locomotive selection: find the required tractive effort from the hauled mass and the ruling gradient, then convert to traction power at the running speed and check the power margin of the model.
map.列车编组：固定机车功率下，反算不同速度等级可牵引的质量，优化编组避免欠速。: Train consist: with locomotive power fixed, back out what mass can be hauled at each speed class, optimizing the consist to avoid falling short of speed.
map.线路牵引计算：结合起动牵引力与持续速度，校核起动加速能力与持续运行工况功率。: Line traction calculation: combine starting tractive effort and sustained speed to check starting acceleration capability and continuous running power.
map.以双机牵引 5000 t 货物列车、限速 108 km/h 校核: Check with a 5000 t freight train hauled by two locomotives at a limited speed of 108 km/h
map.：取机车轮周牵引力 F=300000 N（单机能效点附近），运行速度 v=30: Take a locomotive wheel tractive force of F = 300000 N (near the single-unit efficiency point) at a running speed of v = 30 m/s (108 km/h); the required traction power is P = F x v = 300000 x 30 = 9,000,000 W = 9000 kW. With two units (2 x 4800 kW = 9600 kW available) the margin is about 6.7%, enough for continuous running. Raising the speed to 35 m/s (126 km/h) needs 10,500 kW, above the available power, so you must slow down or add a unit.
map.牵引功率为什么是力乘速度？: Why Is Tractive Power Force Times Speed?
map.轮周功率 P=F×v，其中 F 为轮周牵引力(N)、v 为运行速度(m/s)，单: Wheel power P = F x v, where F is the wheel tractive force (N) and v the running speed (m/s), giving watts; divide by 1000 for kW. Physically it is the work done at the wheel per unit time, and it is the core check for locomotive selection and line traction calculation.
map.限制坡度对功率需求影响多大？: How Much Does the Ruling Gradient Affect Power Demand?
map.限制坡度决定所需挽力（F≈(质量×g×坡度%+阻力)/机车数），坡度越大挽力越大: The ruling gradient sets the required tractive effort (F is about (mass x g x gradient per mille + resistance) / locomotives); the steeper the gradient the more effort needed, and at a given speed power rises linearly with effort. For example, for the same 5000 t, the effort needed on a 12 per mille grade is about double that on a 6 per mille grade, so the power at the same speed roughly doubles; check selection against the worst grade segment.
